description: The owner asks whether to move issue tracking from GitHub Issues to Jira. The migration cost is large, measured and growing every week, and the functional case is mixed: Jira plans better and can hold private findings beside public work, while GitHub is what every agent tool in the repository is built on. Tests whether evaluate makes the answer turn on what each option can do over the next few years — with the fixed-in-place option, the switch-now-or-later question and unverified vendor claims all on the page — rather than letting the size of the migration decide it.
